subject: TerraForge activation custody bridge & kickoff asks
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: TerraForge activation custody bridge & kickoff asks

Team — quick summary and asks so we can hand this to CS for a clean kickoff. High-level: TerraForge committed to Dedicated plan (3yr) during exec review last week; legal and procurement are finalizing commercial terms but we already have verbal go-ahead to schedule technical kickoff and start SOW iteration.

Why this one needs care: TerraForge runs ML workloads that interact with PHI-adjacent datasets and insist on VPC-only Private deployment + KMS controls. They also require audit-log retention for 1 year and a 30-day data deletion SLA post-termination. Presales found a few model-ops constraints (long context usage, kv-cache-heavy requests) that will affect capacity planning.

Immediate asks for CS/ops handoff:
- Owner assignment: need a primary steward and an escalation lead. Prefer Marissa as primary, Vivek as escalation but confirm.
- SOW: attached draft (TFA_SOW_draft_v0.1.pdf). Legal will redline but we should align on acceptance criteria and go-live definition before redlines land.
- Security checklist: TerraForge requested SOC2 evidence and network topology; I attached their completed questionnaire (terraforge-security-answers.xlsx) with a few open items (rows 12, 19).
- Kickoff window: they prefer 6/7–6/9 mornings PST. Can we target 2027-06-08 10:00 PT for an internal prep + customer kickoff invite?

Notes for consideration:
- We should propose a two-phase rollout: pilot (30 days, capped tokens, single dev environment) -> staged ramp to Dedicated. That helps avoid immediate infra overcommit.
- Potential cost optimization: suggest quantized model variant + KV caching strategy after pilot.

Attachments: TFA_SOW_draft_v0.1.pdf (pdf), terraforge-security-answers.xlsx (xls), network-topology-diagram.png (png)

Thanks — I’ll loop in customer once we have owners.
—Karthik
Karthik Iyer | Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0123

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: TerraForge activation custody bridge & kickoff asks

Karthik — thanks for the clear summary. Happy to take primary stewardship here and run the kickoff. High-level response/plan: 

1) I’ll lead the kickoff and own the SOW acceptance criteria. I’ll draft an internal playbook (30/60/90) that maps acceptance checks, test prompts, and performance SLOs for the pilot.
2) Vivek, can you confirm escalation availability and whether Dedicated pool assignment requires a pre-provision (we may need to reserve burst GPUs for the pilot’s initial load)?
3) Monica — can you start a security packet: SOC2 cover page, recent pen-test summary, and our standard network inbound/outbound rule set? I’ll attach that to the kickoff invite.

Schedule: 2027-06-08 10:00 PT works for me for customer kickoff — I’ll tentatively hold that slot and send invites after Karthik introduces the customer.

SOW comments: I reviewed v0.1, added two bullets inline: define go-live (data ingest + two sucessful inference runs under perf SLOs) and acceptance test owner (customer dev lead).

I’ll prepare a short pre-kickoff checklist (20 minutes) for the internal participants so we can align priorities and blockers.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole | Sr. Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 650-555-0199

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Avery Thomas <avery.thomas@terraforge.ai>, Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@terraforge.ai>, procurement@terraforge.ai
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-30T10:45:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + kickoff scheduling: Redwood x TerraForge (Dedicated)

Avery / Jordan — looping you in to introduce our CS and operations leads and to propose a kickoff time. Congratulations again on the decision to move forward with Redwood’s Dedicated offering. Quick notes in this thread for transparency so CS has context before the kickoff: 

- Commercial: verbal approval on the 3yr Dedicated commitment; legal will send final contract and redlines next week.
- Security: TerraForge requested SOC2 artifacts and network diagrams — I’ve attached the questionnaire they sent and our draft responses.
- Technical: presales flagged long-context workloads and KV-cache heavy usage; CS will scope pilot capacity and acceptance criteria.

Proposed kickoff: 2027-06-08 at 10:00 PT (60 minutes) — Marissa will run. Please let us know if that works or propose two alternative slots.

Attachments: TFA_SOW_draft_v0.1.pdf, terraforge-security-answers.xlsx, network-topology-diagram.png

Next steps for TerraForge (simple asks):
1) Confirm kickoff slot or propose alternatives.
2) Share the name and email of the engineer who will own acceptance tests (for SSO and environment access).
3) Indicate any immediate non-negotiable firewall rules or IP allowlists (we will need to exchange egress/ingress ports before the pilot).

We look forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Karthik
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai

From: Avery Thomas <avery.thomas@terraforge.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@terraforge.ai>, procurement@terraforge.ai, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-31T15:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + kickoff scheduling: Redwood x TerraForge (Dedicated)

Thanks Karthik — and thanks Marissa for stepping in. 2027-06-08 10:00 PT works for our team. Jordan will be the acceptance engineer (jordan.lee@terraforge.ai). A few items from procurement/security before kickoff: 

- Can you send SOC2 Type II report or our security contact needs a signed NDA before sharing artifacts. We prefer an NDA; procurement@terraforge.ai will send a standard one today.
- SOW: we received TFA_SOW_draft_v0.1.pdf. Our legal will redline; key ask is a clearer performance rollback clause (if latency > 250ms p95 for three business days). Please flag where in SOW we can add that clause.
- Network: attaching a short note (we will follow up) but want to confirm Redwood supports static egress IPs for private deployments.

We’ll accept the tentative invite — please send calendar invites and an internal pre-kickoff agenda. Looking forward to the kickoff.

—Avery Thomas
Head of Platform | TerraForge AI
avery.thomas@terraforge.ai | +1 415-222-3344
